title: Awaken The Giant Within
author: Tony Robbins
blurb: Tony Robbins argues that the quality of your life comes down to a handful of things you can control: your decisions, your beliefs, and how you manage your emotions. He begins with the claim that a real decision, one that cuts off every other option, can change your direction in a moment. Then he explains the forces underneath our choices: we act to avoid pain and gain pleasure, and we can deliberately link new feelings to old habits. He shows how beliefs, the questions we habitually ask, and even the words we use to describe our experiences shape how we feel. He goes on to values and rules, the hidden compass behind every choice, and to identity, the deepest driver of all. The book closes with practical challenges for building lasting change through constant small improvement.

lessons.t: One Real Decision Can Change Everything
lessons.b: Your destiny is shaped in moments of decision, and a true decision means committing to a result and cutting off every other possibility.
